question: What is the colour of the flame when unsaturated hydrocarbons burn?
solution:
The correct answer is __**yellow.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When** unsaturated hydrocarbons burn**, they produce a** yellow flame** due to the presence of **carbon particles** in the flame.
